title: qthe subject-key pre-registration (cross-examination batteries)
description: Machine-usable schema for the SUBJECT-KEY law (docs/SUBJECT-KEY.md). A cross-examination battery MUST be pre-registered in this shape BEFORE any LLM call: every pair carries code-computed subject keys (artifact_key + '::' + claim_id), the contested claim ids, a pairing reason, and a pre-registered expected relation. The model judges same-issue-ness only within a subject or across two explicitly-tagged subjects; it never infers subject identity. Pairs whose keys cannot be computed in code are refusals (curator queue), never model guesses.

registered_under.description: Pointer to the round registration / lane spec that froze this battery.

source.description: The sealed corpus the findings/entries come from (file path or git ref + path).

sha256.description: sha256 of the exact corpus bytes the tags were made against.

claim_registry.description: The pre-registered contested-claim taxonomy. Sealed BEFORE pairing; amendments are append-only with receipts.

claim_id.description: Stable claim id (snake_case). Names the CONTESTED CLAIM, not the experiment.

artifact_key.description: Canonical artifact this claim is about (must be producible by the pinned normalization table or a literal artifact_path).

artifact_path.description: Repo path of the artifact when one exists (e.g. receipts/e_q16_chain.jsonl).

claim_statement.description: One-sentence statement of what is contested (the claim, AS receipted in the provenance).

provenance_receipt.description: Where this claim distinction comes from (verdict numbered finding, adjudication row, judgment call + receipt).

amends.description: For append-only amendments: the claim_id superseded by this entry (the superseded entry stays in the registry history).

artifact_normalization_table.description: Pinned mapping from artifact text AS SAID in the sealed corpus to canonical artifact_key. Every mapping carries a receipt. A corpus text not in this table makes its pairs UNCOMPUTABLE -> refusal (R4), never a guess.

artifact_text_as_said.description: The artifact field text VERBATIM as the sealed source stated it (AS-SAID).

co_named_artifacts.description: Other artifacts named in the same text (receipted; not part of the key).

receipt.description: Why this text normalizes to this key.

pairs.description: The pre-registered pair list. Every field here is sealed BEFORE any LLM call.

subject_key_a.description: artifact_key + '::' + claim_id, computed in code for side A.

subject_key_b.description: artifact_key + '::' + claim_id, computed in code for side B.

subject_claim_ids.description: [claim_id_a, claim_id_b] -- the contested claims, from the claim registry.

same_subject.description: subject_key_a == subject_key_b, computed by string comparison in code. NEVER derived from model output.

pairing_reason.description: Why this pair is in the battery (e.g. 'confusable boundary: both describe the E-Q16 correction').

expected_relation.description: The curator's pre-registered expectation, from the claim registry -- a prediction sealed before any call.

routing.description: Computed by the pairing code per R3: equal keys -> the identity question is decided in code (model asked only within-subject questions); different keys -> the same-entity question is BARRED, model may be asked the cross-subject same-issue question whose yes is curator amendment evidence; uncomputable keys -> refusal.

refusals.description: Pairs NOT paired because a subject key was not computable in code (R4). Each is a curator-queue receipt, not a model question.

reason.description: What was missing: artifact text not in the pinned table, missing claim tag, unparsable path.

append_only.description: This pre-registration is never edited after sealing; corrections are append-only entries with receipts.

no_model_output_in_keys.description: Declaration: subject_key_*, subject_claim_ids, same_subject and routing were computed without any LLM output.

preregistration_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of this file's content (pairs + registries + tables), sealed before the first call.

source_ref.description: Where this side's finding/entry lives in the sealed corpus (e.g. 'arena_rows_r10.jsonl :: mimov26f/F5' or 'verify_all_chains.mjs @ 74bc4b5^ :: tests/receipts.jsonl').

artifact_text_as_said.description: The artifact field VERBATIM as the sealed source stated it (AS-SAID; never paraphrased).

artifact_key.description: Canonical key from the pinned normalization table (or the literal path for path-keyed corpora).

claim_id.description: From the claim registry. Constant tag (e.g. 'chain_reference') is allowed ONLY with a receipted rule declaring the corpus's claim dimension constant.
